name: Lethal Lair
author: TakoBoi123
description: In this Action RPG Adventure, take the role as the brave Warrior set to free his home from the grip of the Dark Lord! Walk into the threshold of this Dark Lord's den and face challenging foes and monsters! Scale the tower full of traps that will leave even the bravest of heroes shivering! What secrets await you in the Lethal Lair?!
